annotations.title: Player Props Research, Model & Cheat Sheet

description: Use this when the user asks about a player's prop lines, how often he clears a line, or today's prop board. Returns, for a player_id, one compact row per stat with a line for his next game: the consensus line and book count, his last five games against it (`l5`, values newest first) and his season average; signed in, the last ten (`l10`, newest first) and his record against the closing line; with Keel Stats Pro also L20 and season hit rates, the opening line and move, the model's probability against the market's, the best price at the consensus line (`best_over`/`best_under` name their line; a better line at another book follows as `other_line`) and the matchup, and with `detail` the book-by-book odds, closing lines, game log, history and alternate ladders. Without a player_id, today's prop board: `recent` is the last five values newest first, `status` the injury report's (questionable, doubtful…), `minutes_l5` and `fga_l5`/`tpa_l5` the last five games' minutes and attempts; players ruled out are listed in `ruled_out`, not in the rows (Pro: model edge, the daily cheat sheet and the `consistent` filter). The answer's `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Not for picks: it is research only and never gives a pick.

consistent.description: Optional, the board only (Keel Stats Pro): true keeps the players whose last 5 and last 10 games both went one way against today's line (70%+ over, or 70%+ under), read over the whole board before it is cut to its rows.

date.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the NBA daily prop board.

detail.description: With a player_id (Keel Stats Pro): "compact" (default), "full" (every section, the long answer), or a comma-separated list of sections: "books" (book-by-book odds and history), "ladders" (alternate lines graded), "closes" (closing lines per game), "games" (the game log with closes), "history" (record against the close by season).

game_id.description: Optional numeric game ID to filter the daily prop board to a single game.

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID to inspect his lines for the next game. Omit for the daily prop board.

stat.description: Optional stat code: narrows a player's rows and sections, or picks the board's stat (e.g. NBA: "pts", "reb", "ast", "tpm", "pra"; NFL: "passing_yards", "rushing_yards", "receiving_yards", "receptions").
